scope: London-based or meaningfully London-active public figures across entrepreneurship, technology, marketing, creator business, property and wealth, ranked for Phil’s goals.
method: Ranking reflects relevance to Phil and realistic public access, not a definitive follower league table.
Meeting routes are public professional channels only. Private locations, personal contact details and speculative hangouts are excluded.
Audience counts are omitted because reliable current first-party figures were not consistently available.

influencers.name: Simon Squibb
influencers.london_connection: London-facing founder community through HelpBnk and public founder activity.
influencers.why_relevant: One of the strongest fits for practical entrepreneurship, public content and meeting aspiring founders.
influencers.known_for: Entrepreneur, creator and HelpBnk founder.
influencers.public_route: HelpBnk events, public founder meet-ups and speaking appearances announced through his channels.
influencers.approach: Attend to contribute first. Ask a concise question about building in public or helping early founders.
influencers.evidence_note: Official Simon Squibb and HelpBnk sites confirm current founder-focused public activity.

influencers.name: Daniel Priestley
influencers.london_connection: Dent Global operates UK programmes and London-facing business events.
influencers.why_relevant: Directly aligned with founder-led positioning, audience building, offers and scaling a business.
influencers.known_for: Entrepreneur, author, speaker and Dent Global co-founder.
influencers.public_route: Dent Global London events, programmes and published speaking appearances.
influencers.approach: Attend a public Dent session and ask about converting expertise into a scalable product or media asset.
influencers.evidence_note: Official sites confirm his business education platform and public programmes.

influencers.name: Ranjan Bhattacharya
influencers.london_connection: Runs the recurring Baker Street Property Meet in central London.
influencers.why_relevant: A highly practical route into the London property-investor network and deal conversations.
influencers.known_for: Property investor, educator and London property-meet host.
influencers.public_route: Attend the Baker Street Property Meet repeatedly and participate in its networking sessions.
influencers.approach: Become a regular, ask one deal-specific question and follow up with attendees before requesting time from the host.
influencers.evidence_note: Official event page confirms the recurring Baker Street property community and public attendance route.

influencers.name: Simon Zutshi
influencers.london_connection: Property Investors Network runs meetings and programmes with London attendance routes.
influencers.why_relevant: Useful for both property education and meeting active investors through an established recurring network.
influencers.known_for: Property investor, author and founder of Property Investors Network.
influencers.public_route: Attend a published London PIN meeting or public PIN event.
influencers.approach: Choose one London group and attend consistently rather than travelling between one-off seminars.
influencers.evidence_note: Official sites confirm his property education work and the public PIN meeting network.

influencers.name: Sophie Miller
influencers.london_connection: Pretty Little Marketer operates a UK creator and marketing community with London-facing events.
influencers.why_relevant: Strong fit for social content, audience growth, brand community and meeting working marketers.
influencers.known_for: Founder of Pretty Little Marketer and marketing creator.
influencers.public_route: Pretty Little Marketer community events, workshops and public speaking appearances.
influencers.approach: Attend with one current content experiment and ask for a specific critique rather than a broad networking chat.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms the active marketing community, education and event platform.

influencers.name: Amelia Sordell
influencers.london_connection: Klowt is a London personal-brand agency with public founder-led content and events.
influencers.why_relevant: Direct relevance to Phil’s personal brand, LinkedIn strategy and founder-led audience building.
influencers.known_for: Founder of Klowt and personal-brand creator.
influencers.public_route: Klowt events, public workshops and London marketing or founder conferences.
influencers.approach: Bring a sharply defined positioning question and reference one specific piece of her work.
influencers.evidence_note: Official Klowt site confirms the London personal-brand business and public content platform.

influencers.name: Ali Abdaal
influencers.london_connection: UK creator with London-facing creator, book and business appearances.
influencers.why_relevant: One of the clearest models for turning YouTube content into products, systems and a creator-led company.
influencers.known_for: YouTube educator, author and creator entrepreneur.
influencers.public_route: Public creator conferences, book events and business talks announced through official channels.
influencers.approach: Target a public Q&A. Ask about a specific bottleneck in building a repeatable YouTube production system.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms his UK creator business, content and public work.

influencers.name: Steven Bartlett
influencers.london_connection: Founder of London-based Flight Group with a major UK podcast and public-event presence.
influencers.why_relevant: A leading example of founder storytelling, media leverage, podcasting and personal-brand scale.
influencers.known_for: Entrepreneur and host of The Diary of a CEO.
influencers.public_route: Diary of a CEO live events, major business conferences and announced public appearances.
influencers.approach: Treat this as a long-term target. Build credible work first and use a public Q&A or professional media pitch.
influencers.evidence_note: Official personal and podcast sites confirm the current UK business and media platform; Flight Group is identified through his public company activity.

influencers.name: Rory Sutherland
influencers.london_connection: Vice-chairman at Ogilvy UK and a frequent London marketing-event speaker.
influencers.why_relevant: Exceptionally useful for sales messaging, behavioural economics, positioning and memorable creative ideas.
influencers.known_for: Ogilvy advertising leader, author and behavioural-science speaker.
influencers.public_route: London advertising, behavioural-science and marketing conferences, including public Ogilvy appearances.
influencers.approach: Ask about a real pricing, positioning or customer-behaviour problem rather than requesting general advice.
influencers.evidence_note: Official Ogilvy UK presence and public professional profile establish his London advertising role.

influencers.name: Rob Dix
influencers.london_connection: Runs UK property media and public activity relevant to the London market.
influencers.why_relevant: A credible fit for investment strategy, property content and building a media-led property business.
influencers.known_for: Property investor, author and Property Hub co-founder.
influencers.public_route: Property Hub events, podcast appearances, webinars and public talks announced on official channels.
influencers.approach: Reference a specific Property Podcast idea and ask how it changes a live deal decision.
influencers.evidence_note: Official sites confirm his active property education, media and investment work.

influencers.name: Rob Bence
influencers.london_connection: Property Hub’s UK investor platform covers London and runs public-facing media and events.
influencers.why_relevant: Relevant to property deal analysis, investor communities and building an education-led property brand.
influencers.known_for: Property investor and Property Hub co-founder.
influencers.public_route: Property Hub public events, webinars and podcast-related appearances.
influencers.approach: Use a public event and lead with one well-researched London deal question.
influencers.evidence_note: Official Property Hub site confirms the current investor education and media platform.

influencers.name: Piers Linney
influencers.london_connection: London entrepreneur and investor with regular UK business and technology appearances.
influencers.why_relevant: Strong overlap with SaaS, entrepreneurship, investment, leadership and scaling companies.
influencers.known_for: Entrepreneur, investor and former Dragons’ Den investor.
influencers.public_route: Public technology conferences, founder panels and speaking events listed through official channels.
influencers.approach: Ask a narrow question about moving from sales-led traction to scalable SaaS operations.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms his entrepreneur, investor and public-speaking activity.

influencers.name: Grace Beverley
influencers.london_connection: Founder of London-based TALA with frequent London business and brand appearances.
influencers.why_relevant: A strong example of converting a personal audience into consumer brands and operational businesses.
influencers.known_for: Founder of TALA and creator entrepreneur.
influencers.public_route: TALA brand events, founder conferences and public business talks.
influencers.approach: Use a public event and ask about the transition from creator-led demand to a company that can outgrow its founder.
influencers.evidence_note: Official personal and TALA sites confirm her active London-founded business and creator work.

influencers.name: Harry Stebbings
influencers.london_connection: 20VC is a London venture and media platform.
influencers.why_relevant: Highly relevant to startup fundraising, SaaS growth, investor thinking and founder interviews.
influencers.known_for: Founder of 20VC and host of The Twenty Minute VC.
influencers.public_route: 20VC public events, major startup conferences and announced podcast-related appearances.
influencers.approach: Long-term target. Build a distinctive SaaS result or viewpoint before approaching through a public event.
influencers.evidence_note: Official 20VC sites confirm the London venture firm and media platform.

influencers.name: Patricia Bright
influencers.london_connection: London creator and entrepreneur with UK fashion, finance and business media activity.
influencers.why_relevant: Useful model for long-term YouTube growth, brand partnerships and diversifying a creator business.
influencers.known_for: YouTube creator, entrepreneur and finance-content host.
influencers.public_route: Creator-economy conferences, brand events and public talks announced through official channels.
influencers.approach: Ask a creator-business question at a public event rather than approaching through lifestyle fandom.
influencers.evidence_note: Official YouTube channel confirms her active creator and business content platform.

influencers.name: Gary Stevenson
influencers.london_connection: London is central to his public economics work and former trading career.
influencers.why_relevant: Useful for understanding wealth, markets, inequality and communicating complex financial ideas clearly.
influencers.known_for: Economics creator, author and former trader.
influencers.public_route: Public book talks, economics events, lectures and announced live appearances.
influencers.approach: Attend a public Q&A and ask one evidence-led question about capital, housing or wealth concentration.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms the active economics education, book and public-content platform.

influencers.name: James Shack
influencers.london_connection: UK property and financial-planning creator whose analysis frequently covers London-relevant decisions.
influencers.why_relevant: Strong overlap with property investing, personal finance and evidence-led market analysis.
influencers.known_for: Chartered financial planner and property/finance YouTube creator.
influencers.public_route: Public talks, livestreams and finance or property conferences announced through his channel.
influencers.approach: Ask a quantified question about a real investment trade-off and avoid generic “where should I invest?” questions.
influencers.evidence_note: Official channel confirms current UK property and personal-finance publishing.

influencers.name: Anna Clare Harper
influencers.london_connection: London-facing residential investment strategist with public UK property commentary and media work.
influencers.why_relevant: Relevant to institutional property thinking, residential trends and sophisticated investor conversations.
influencers.known_for: Residential investment strategist, author and podcast host.
influencers.public_route: Property conferences, podcast events, webinars and public speaking listed through official channels.
influencers.approach: Lead with a current London housing thesis and ask where your assumptions are weakest.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms her active residential investment, media and public-speaking work.

influencers.name: Nicole Bremner
influencers.london_connection: London property developer and entrepreneur with public books, podcasts and speaking activity.
influencers.why_relevant: Relevant to development, raising capital, personal-brand-led property content and entrepreneurial resilience.
influencers.known_for: Property developer, author and podcast host.
influencers.public_route: Property conferences, podcast appearances and public talks announced on official channels.
influencers.approach: Ask about a specific development or capital-raising lesson, not a broad request for mentorship.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms her London property-development and public media work.

influencers.name: Samuel Leeds
influencers.london_connection: Runs UK property training and public events, including London-facing activity when scheduled.
influencers.why_relevant: Large property-education platform and accessible events, although any paid programme should be assessed carefully on its merits.
influencers.known_for: Property investor, creator and training-business founder.
influencers.public_route: Only attend a London event or webinar currently listed on his official site; check terms and upsells first.
influencers.approach: Use a low-commitment public event. Do not make a large purchase solely for networking access.
influencers.evidence_note: Official site confirms active UK property education, content and public events.
